body: When many people think about the spiritual life what comes to their mind is alife of performing various religious functions like worship, prayer, meditation, singing, dancing and reading. When someone does these things very sincerely many think that makes them spiri¬ tual. None of that necessarily has anything to do with what spiritual truly is. Spiritual is the very nature of what you already are. There's nothing to do about it except to Realize it. Once you have made this discovery it's all over. Then there is literally nothing more to do. When Irealized this, it shocked me for days. 6 0
